spec_match.rationale: Implements the spec's recipe (content: "ⓘ" / "" on a[interestfor], with an any-pointer: coarse option). It shows immediate interest and no navigation from the pseudo, and that taps on the text still navigate.

interactive.rationale: Three mode radios, three hovercard links and a working Follow button. The live log records interest/loseinterest with event.source, TAP, NAVIGATE and ANCHOR geometry.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers off/coarse/always, navigation versus interest, and keyboard focus. Hover-delay interplay is left to the parent feature's demos.

conformance.rationale: It backs the feature suite: box-generated / opt-in / valid-source assertions run live. 6 pass and 2 blocked with the flag. Without it, 3 pass, 3 fail and 2 blocked, which is honest.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment). Run with default flags and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, at 1280x800 and at 360x740 DPR3 touch. Every control was exercised, console, pageerror and failed requests were all zero, and overflow was 0px in every run. Flag: a tap or click on the pseudo logs INTEREST (source l-ada) then 'did NOT navigate'. Default: no box (width auto) and the fallback banner is shown. Not verified on a real Android touchscreen.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the labelled fallback branch, and load-time asserts wait for DOMContentLoaded because the telemetry script is deferred.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only. Button background overrides also set color, and contrast is checked (accent-blue on paper is 7.86:1).

accessibility.rationale: The links remain the keyboard path (focus shows interest, verified). The pseudo is not focusable by spec. Accessibility-tree absence was not inspected (no DevTools MCP).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360 and 1280. The ⓘ is 44px. Coarse-only mode is verified to generate on the touch context and not on desktop.

openQuestions.title: Verify on a real Android touchscreen
openQuestions.detail: Headless touch emulation was used. Confirm on a device that tapping the ⓘ opens the card and that long-press on the link still shows the context menu with 'Show details'.

openQuestions.title: Re-check popover re-anchoring to the pseudo
openQuestions.detail: interest_button_pseudo_element.cc re-anchors an open popover to the ::interest-button, but Chrome 153 left the card aligned with the link (0px delta). Re-test on Canary and update the 'anchoring' note.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use popover=hint targets with interestfor and position them with the implicit anchor via position-area and position-try-fallbacks. Do not add role=tooltip or aria-describedby by hand.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The cards are popover=hint with position-area: block-end span-inline-end and flip fallbacks. No manual ARIA wiring was added.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rich hovercards may contain interactive content. Gate entry/exit transitions behind prefers-reduced-motion.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The profile cards contain a real Follow toggle (aria-pressed). The fade transition only applies under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (tap-for-hovercard).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async status with a single polite region, and size targets at least 24px (bump them up on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Logs use role=log or polite regions. The pseudo and fallback buttons have min 44x44px and every other control is 44px tall.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in the same pass. Evidence is from headless Chrome 153 with and without the runtime flag. chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable, so accessibility-tree claims are unverified.
